_about: Note requests (#1040), shared byte for byte by nora (nora/tests/note_request_vectors.json) and the Hermes fork (tests/gateway/note_request_vectors.json): the gateway routes on the same words nora reads. notes: [message, the note nora writes]. asks: a request with nothing to note (NORA asks what to note). not_notes: never a note request. reminders: note-shaped requests with a moment, which the gateway sets as reminders.
